name: active-digit-ai
description: Build real hosted WordPress websites, online stores, landing pages and sample CRM workspaces from a short description, and get a live link.

interface.longDescription: Describe a business in Hebrew, Arabic or English and Active Digit AI builds and hosts a real WordPress website on its own address with HTTPS: an online store (WooCommerce, categories, products, cart, mobile layout) or a business site, a landing page, or a sample CRM workspace, then returns the live link. Ask for changes in plain language (add products, change texts or colours) and the same site updates. It can also turn a request for a booking system or custom software into a structured specification. Products, prices and contacts it generates are clearly marked as sample content until you replace them. Works without an account; connecting an Active Digit account keeps projects in that account.
defaultPrompt: Build a sales website for my clothing store Fashion Style in Hebrew, with women's and men's categories.
Create a landing page in Arabic for my beauty salon Noor.
Set up a sample CRM for my real-estate agency with the stages New, Viewing, Offer, Closed.
